## Summary

- describe the change
- call out user-facing behavior changes

## Validation

- [ ] `corepack pnpm run typecheck`
- [ ] `corepack pnpm run test`
- [ ] `corepack pnpm run lint`

## Scope check

- [ ] docs updated if command, policy, or output changed
- [ ] tests added or updated for meaningful behavior changes
- [ ] no unrelated files changed
